result.stdout:
Description:
  Interactive CIL REPL with a live evaluation stack. Type IL, watch the stack, run it.

Usage:
  ilrepl [<script>] [options]

Arguments:
  <script>  An IL script to run, one line per instruction.

Options:
  -e, --eval <eval>  Run IL lines separated by ';' and exit. ret runs the cell.
  --no-color         Plain output without ANSI colors.
  -q, --quiet        Do not echo the stack after each instruction.
  --batch            Read lines from standard input without the terminal UI.
  -?, -h, --help     Show help and usage information
  --version          Show version information
